description:
## What's New in 0.2.0

- **LINE `26.19.0` (`261900178`) full target port**: Updated target version validation, ARM64 and Universal APKM input hashes, obfuscated DEX hooks, runtime reflection adapters, and contract/runtime tests for LINE `26.19.0`.
- **Settings row 13-parameter register fix & boolean field tracing**: Fixed the Dalvik 4-bit register overflow (`v16 > v15`) in `SettingsPatch.kt` for LINE `26.19.0`'s 13-parameter `Lti5/a0;<init>` by loading high-register copied fields through dead low scratch `v1` (`move-object/from16` / `move/from16`) and using `const/16` for null/zero above `v15`; added `Opcode.IPUT_BOOLEAN` to `fieldOfArgument`.
- **Settings UI header & row state compatibility**: Updated `SettingsPage` to invoke `Header.setUpButtonVisibility$common_libs(Z)V` following LINE's Gradle module rename, and explicitly disabled `duplicateParentState` (`setDuplicateParentStateEnabled(false)` + `row.setEnabled(available)`) on `line_user_settings_text_item_view.xml` rows so enabled, disabled, and pressed states render cleanly.
- **Mute DAO DI migration, unread metadata, RxJava observer & Glide updates**: Refactored `NativeLine.muted()` to resolve LINE's main `ch8.c` DAO via DI (`bd0.f.a(context, ch8.c$a.c)`) and read `eh8.e.b`; updated `NativeLine.chat()` total unread lookup to `Lln3/k$d;->b`; updated `ReadActions` `q08.b` observer dispatch for the `onComplete()` / `b(r08.b)` method swap; updated Glide loading to `o.j()`, `n.W()`, and `n.X(Integer.MIN_VALUE, Integer.MIN_VALUE)` (replacing the removed 0-arg `submit()`).
- **Coroutine bridge, notification hooks & native action resource IDs**: Rebound `NotificationContinuation` to `Lsm8/c;` (verified against `Lyl3/f;->t` `check-cast Lsm8/c;`); updated notification hooks (`Landroidx/core/app/r;->a`, `Lh34/f;->b` 9-register `suppressBuilder`, `Li60/a4;<init>` 17-parameter/18-register field `l` / `v12`, `Lyi8/n;->b,c` flattened `Landroidx/core/app/h;` with inlined `Landroidx/core/app/z;<init>` and `Landroidx/core/app/h$a;->f`, `Lkk8/c3;->f`, `Lk34/i;->b`, `Lyi8/a;->d`, `Li60/w1;->invoke`, `Lu52/i;<init>`, `Lt72/c;->E5`, `Lyb8/f;->n`) and native action string resource IDs (`0x7f152a17` mute / `0x7f152a18` reply).

### Included Patches (LINE `26.19.0` / `261900178`, Patcher `2.3.0`, all `default = true`)
- `Notification settings`: Adds localized patch settings UI & notification button presets.
- `Not Too Much Silent`: Local silent mode (chat menu, chat-list long-press, notification shade) with opt-in `@mention` & keyword alert bypass + complete hide.
- `More Chat Info`: Android `MessagingStyle` conversation preview (configurable `1–25` recent unread) + total unread count + typed & detailed attachment labels + optional inline photo/sticker previews + local-cache sender avatars.
- `No reply`: Hides smart-reply chips while keeping manual inline reply.
- `Mark as read`: Marks whole regular chat read via LINE's native chat-list updater.
- `Restore push registration`: Restores Firebase installation registration after re-signing (`X-Android-Cert` only).

### Verification & Notes
- Verified with 224 `NotificationPolicy` assertions, 279 `ExtensionRuntimeTest` JVM behavioral checks (45 scenarios), 29 Python unit tests, 5 APK static contract suites (3,198 ARM64 & Universal all-features; 3,134 `Mark as read`-only; 3,156 `More Chat Info`-only; 3,176 `Not Too Much Silent`-only), compiled `resources.arsc` checks (77 keys × 7 locales), independent `gpt-6.2-astra` bytecode cross-check, and live Galaxy S10e LINE `26.19.0` same-key upgrade + Smoke A/B/C verification with 0 logcat errors across 47,217 lines.
- Original/patched LINE APKs, APKMs, and signing keys are never distributed. Provide your own official LINE `26.19.0` APKM.
